data.description:
ADD BATCH TASK IMPORT FROM YAML/JSON

FILE: scripts/got_utils.py (add cmd_task_import function)
FILE: cortical/got/api.py (add import_tasks method if needed)

IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Add argparse subcommand: task import FILE [--sprint SPRINT_ID]
2. Support YAML and JSON formats
3. Each task entry has: title, priority, category, description (optional)
4. Validate entries before creating
5. Report created task IDs

YAML FORMAT EXAMPLE:
```yaml
tasks:
  - title: "Task one"
    priority: high
    category: feature
  - title: "Task two"
    priority: medium
```

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- python scripts/got_utils.py task import tasks.yaml works
- Validates required fields (title, priority)
- Returns list of created task IDs
- Test with: echo '{"tasks":[{"title":"Test","priority":"low","category":"test"}]}' > /tmp/test.json

GUARDRAILS - DO NOT:
- Modify existing task commands
- Break existing CLI structure
- Add external dependencies

VERIFY: python scripts/got_utils.py task import --help

properties.retrospective: Added task import command with YAML/JSON support. Tested with both formats.

data.title: Add batch task import from YAML/JSON file
